notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.

notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/db35c03d0fda7640f3f2aeb39b155175281e3729.jpg[/img]
Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death. [p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: 
[previewyoutube=zVDyBBJkbxk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

notes.title: Content update DOOMER №1 is available! Changelog post.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44355443/2152978a1c153df1a05982cbf23fa164c59ddb1d.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=n5YBh0wvxQc;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings from the Doomer development team! 

We apologize for the long absence of any news and game updates since the announcement of our roadmap. As is often the case, everything that could go wrong went wrong. As we built all the processes and implemented what we promised, it took more time than expected.

Now that the time has come, we are pleased to present you with the first content update, which is quite significant in scope, but represents only a small part of what's planned.

Let's talk about future plans before we get into the details of the update. From now on, we'll release updates more frequently. We can't reveal the content or dates yet, but there won't be such long breaks between updates anymore. In the next step, we'll rework the technical foundation of the game, optimize everything that's "under the hood", and then start developing game mechanics.  

And yes, you read that right, Doomer will feature game mechanics and a clearly defined gameplay cycle. And naturally, we will add more nostalgic items, references, and elements that are signature to the time. 

Sincerely yours, the Doomer team.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

Now for the content update:

[h3]1) Character:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doomer can now run, jump, and crouch; 
[*] When running, the camera wobbles more intensely than when walking; 
[*] Removed camera shake with the option to turn it on if you want to; 
[*] The phone model has been updated to Pokia :), which is more relevant to the time when the game takes place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a188f61e42894362f6dbb6bd19c2a4fc4ea0527a.png[/img]

[*] The phone interface has been updated with the ability to call, but no one will answer...yet.
[*] The ability to take photos through the phone has been removed, since it does not correspond to the time of the game. We will get back to this and explore ideas of how to do photos and screenshots later. However, it won't be done with the phone camera, that is for sure.
[*] A redesigned item interaction system has been added. For example, the rat isn't a part of your pocket anymore. It lives in the cage. You can get it out and put it back in.
[*] Like any doomer character can now die, there are several ways to do that. Feel free to experiment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/3e68d2ac9c7474b79bd45d5cb99dbf2d07a1ff5e.png[/img]

[h3]2) Doomers apartment: [/h3]
[list]
[*] You are able to open and close almost all of the doors and windows in the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/5cff5bcf28629d3bccc022a901099b6a09f0aeee.png[/img]

[*] Now, there are switches in all rooms, so lights can be turned on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/b3d54fe0f6aa26a5e0e0a21749cc4e7d1b02a681.png[/img]

[*] A gas stove can be lit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/98dfcd234bd4ae7c34de82ee0425524b897f0adf.png[/img]

[*] Lots and lots of authentic items that are appropriate for the time the events of the game take place. Brand new models of items made from scratch, including Dendy consoles, cartridges, videotapes, books, Great Dragon and Technics of Youth magazines, as well as video and audio tape recorders. There is no sense to list it all, just explore and enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/da0d2dc40de74973c52b9f4b9aafbb0ba00a3db3.png[/img]

[*] It is now possible to pick up and inspect items. At the moment, not all of the items are eligible for that, but we will be gradually adding the ability to inspect them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/d0462bd2891aadd4e39545f58ff27014393bbe9f.png[/img]

[*] You can now watch TV

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/4733d70221e4a1471087a9f3680376decc5c4f2c.png[/img]

[*] The apartment has a telephone now, you should expect a call.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/0d68cd37f25ba3bc4c6c04775a1246941081907a.png[/img]

[*] There has been a change in the apartment's furnishings. Now that Doomer has a new table, he has rearranged some stuff around the apartment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/a0829a33c001b6476d352c65d53fc1b5737e4da3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]3) Other: [/h3]
[list]
[*] The apartment building has the entrance now, you can access it from the doomers apartment. It allows you to go out onto the street, or access the roof. We attempted to make the entrance as authentic as possible using relevant objects and attributes of the time, writings on the walls, ashtrays, bottles, etc. You can explore, ring your neighbors doorbells and find ways to entertain yourself, maybe getting an achievement or two while you are at it. We'll add more activities over time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/21af654deca04ab7b71da3c2f58b8e0c5866fc48.png[/img]

[*] You can access the roof now. There you can walk around, smoke a cigarette and contemplate about your life while looking at the surrounding landscape from above. That, and all other sorts of activities you can think of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/ed588cf12a3e2d49c65d176816eb067478b96803.png[/img]

[*] The lighting has been updated, smoothly transitioning to dynamic lighting;
[*] A variety of ambient sounds, clocks, birds outside the window, street noise, computer startup, and others have been added;
[*] Picked bottles can be thrown anywhere if you click the left mouse button after picking them up. Give it a try, experiment with it...
[*] The railroad in the area is now fully operational. Watch the departing train doomer and think about life...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/22e9c53431eab3db83538a30e8ebaa4288659f6a.png[/img]

[*] There are many hidden activities now. We won't reveal them, but we are sure you'll enjoy finding them. Don't be afraid to explore the neighborhood and the apartment, something interesting is surely waiting for you there.
[*] Lines 97 is now installed on the computer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/148831f1c301faefebc99afe8b59060462602009.png[/img]

[*] Several parked cars appeared on the streets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/f6c1c58ff973e05e6ba858dcb99dbe29dbb768d2.png[/img]

[*] The apartment buildings themselves were embellished with authentic external elements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41375276/39c98f3492ff6d169f16dc25766b04390af4f81d.png[/img]

[*] Old achievements have been remade to match the spirit of the game and the changes we've made. You'll find new secret achievements as well, look for ways to unlock them and just have fun.  
[/list]

[h3]Enjoy the game!!![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793150/Doomer/[/url]

notes.title: Devblog #2 - Release date confirmed, last level finishes up.
notes.content:
After going radio silent for a week I return with some really, really good news.

First and foremost, the last level of the first episode is finished, I'm currently testing it out and seeing if I can break it before I upload a beta build to steam. After a couple days of it being there, if there aren't any issues, I will be launching the game on [b]february 10th[/b]. Yes, you can quote me on that.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/3c5bdc3d87f763539e11a5dc8898de8920700fc3.jpg[/img]

I have to tell you though, making this level was not easy at all, I had so many ideas that never saw the light of day, but I hope that the way I created things work out for the better and I hope to use those scrapped ideas in the future someway.

So here's a bit of information for the last level for those of you who've been wanting to play it:
[list]
  [*]There's a way to kill the demon.
  [*]There's a way to escape without killing him.
  [*]The last level has 5 different variations depending on what you do.
[/list]

It goes without saying that there are multiple endings for what happens when you finish the last level as well, but I'll leave that for you to find out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/55ea894a743061a3d64b1a22cecaadcd093947cd.jpg[/img]


That's it for now! I've probably already said too much so I hope you'll like what's in store for you.


[url=https://www.facebook.com/ADemonsGame/?ref=bookmarks] Facebook[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/lxFirebal69xl] Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Devblog #1 - Release date, coming changes and more.
notes.content:
Hey gents!

First and foremost, I would like to apologize for my lack of updates the last week, personal life took a big hit and I got extremely busy, but rest assured that updates for the game will follow as soon as possible since I now have time to focus on it.

So what have I got planned?

First piece of news is the upcoming [b]0.4.5 update[/b], it will launch sometime after the next engine update. Most important features of that update are:
[list]
 [*]-Performance boosts. (Thanks to the way lights and objects affect each other being rewritten)
 [*]-Size of the game will drastically decrease. (Thanks to ogg support)
 [*]-More bug fixes.
[/list]

I will keep you updated on when I'm thinking of releasing this patch, and yes it will arrive before the first episode's official launch, speaking of which...

 [b]Release date[/b] for any game is a critical thing to nail down, and looks like I got extremely unlucky this year, as RE7, Outlast 2, Agony, Scorn and a few others are all big horror titles coming out this year, so I have to pick my fights where there aren't any, I was planning to release the game this january, BUT, RE7 comes out at the end of this month, and the month of february doesn't have any big horror releases, so that's going to be my month to shine. [b] I don't have a specific day to release the game yet, but it will arrive in february.[/b]

What have been working on lately is a weird mix of learning and developing, I recently got my hands on Substance Designer 2 and it's an incredible piece of software, as soon as I get more experience with it, I will use it for upcoming episodes.
The development on the last level of the episode has been slow and methodical, since I need every branching path to fit flawlessly, the past 2-3 days have been me exploring the ways the map can branch out while keeping things conclusive and fun.

Here's a few WIP pictures, [b] SPOILERS OF COURSE. [/b]

NOTE THAT THESE ARE VERY EARLY REPRESENTATIONS OF THE FINAL PRODUCT.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/86a49770659f5042e971bb6e270024046732826d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/3090011bfe383a852d9c061022b47525bc56bf02.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/c33011b0c399edca90d849db24ac21c86b415d68.jpg[/img]

That's it for now, more updates coming soon!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/ADemonsGame/?ref=bookmarks] Facebook[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/lxFirebal69xl] Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Steam update #4 - 0.4.2 | New flashlight, health indicators, more bug fixes.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/ec9dc298131bf29d537f12ded6df9cdc5d473bd5.jpg[/img]

General:
-Increased the overall lighting levels of the maps from 7,7,7 -> 10,10,10

-Severely decreased the loading time.

Flashlight-

-Changed the flashlights view cone.

-Made it closer to the screen.

Lucifer sections-

Sewers_1
-Fixed an issue with a few boxes not having physics enabled.

-Fixed a few items not having sounds.
-Replaced the barrel for a crate to ease the water jump.

notes.title: Steam Update #2 - Pre-release patch! 0.4.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27154293/3f1aa0db6e8623504199c37a7bd530b28b9aac34.jpg[/img]

In case you don't want to be spoiled, don't hover the black parts of the text.

General:
-Added the "Let there be more light!" achievement.
-Fixed a crackle noise with the theme in the menu.
-Added a new level to the game. [spoiler](Access it by going over the semi open vault door in the keypad level)[/spoiler]
-Fixed AI not seeing the player when he's jumping or running in a specific direction.
-Fixed AI doing the alert noises too many times.
-Fixed the medpack ocasionally crashing the game, it says "Much better now." when it's used also fixed the text being overlaped with other interactions.

Sewers_2

-Fixed an issue causing the player to go through the walls. lol
-Fixed the water not hitting the player twice.
-Replaced the "fusebox" model to a better one.

Sewers 2_1

-Removed a wooden bridge that was next to a concrete bridge.

Sewers 3:
-Fixed an issue causing the water to hurt you even when you were above it's level.
[spoiler]-Fixed one of the AI's not having alert sound.[/spoiler]
-Fixed the keypad door not opening as it's supposed to (NoWater Version)

Sewers 4_1:
[spoiler]-Fixed AI not going through the circular door.[/spoiler]
-Added more navmesh to make the transition between rooms better.
-Removed the "you can't go back" invisible wall.
[spoiler]-Made it so if the player interacts with the the Sewers 4_2 door it puts him in that level.[/spoiler]
-Added a locked door so the player can't go back into Sewers_3
[spoiler]-Changed the AI patrol route to only include the main room.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Added 2 triggers inside the vents that make the AI go away from you.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Made it so when the vent triggers are triggered another trigger spawns.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Made it so the last trigger mentioned deletes the AI from the map.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Made it so the last trigger mentioned stops playing the chase track and plays the roam track.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Made it so the vent triggers cancel each other out.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Made it so the player can't move while opening the vent doors.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Made it so the player can move again normally after the vent doors are opened.[/spoiler]
-Added text when the vent doors are opening "Opening the vent door..."
-Made it so the text disappears when the doors open.
-Added sounds to the vent (unscrewing sounds with nails falling down.)
-Adjusted a few models that were out of position.
[spoiler]-Added sparkle system to screwdriver (only shows up when one of the vents is interacted with.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Added voice over for the voice transmission.[/spoiler]

notes.content:

Here's the changelog for this update!

General:

-Added a new level to the game. [spoiler](Access it by running through the green door in the keypad level).[/spoiler]
-Improved over 46 textures for the new levels

Sewers_2

-Fixed a note disappearing after it's used.

Sewers 2_1

-Removed a wooden bridge that was next to a concrete bridge.

Sewers 3:
-Fixed the water not making noise when the player is hit. (Lighting)
-Fixed the game not restarting the level. (Exit1)
-Fixed the water not making noise when the player is hit. (Latin)
-Fixed the water not making noise when the player is hit. (Exit2)
-Fixed the water not making noise when the player is hit. (Exit3)
[spoiler]-Fixed an issue causing 2 eaters to roam the sewers (All versions)[/spoiler]
-Entering the correct code on the keypad now removes the player from using it automatically.

Sewers 4_2:
-Redid the lighting. 
-Added a new puzzle (Water versions)
[spoiler]-Fixed the roar behind the door as soon as the player starts playing.[/spoiler]
-Added the sparkle system to objectives.
-Added sparkle system to the consumables.
-Added sparkle system to the phone.

-Minor corrections in the overall level layout.
